title: PCG recovers 1.66 kgs of oil-contaminated waste in Bataan oil spill

blocks.text: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) has transitioned to monitoring operations in Barangay Ipag, Mariveles, Bataan, after its active response efforts recovered 1,660 kilograms of oil-contaminated waste as of Nov. 7. —Photo from PCG MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) has shifted to monitoring operations in Barangay Ipag, Mariveles, Bataan, after recovering 1,660 kilograms of oil-contaminated materials from the affected area as of Saturday, Nov. 7, following an active oil spill response. In an update on Saturday, the PCG said the 83 sacks of recovered waste had been transported to a local transfer station in Mariveles for temporary storage. The […]...
